paper_title: Millimeter-wave WISP search with coherent Light-Shining-Through-a-Wall towards the STAX project
notes: Projection (2-sigma) for a millimeter-wave LSW dark photon search at 30 GHz (mass range ~1e-4 to 1e-3 eV). This is an LSW proposal, NOT a dark matter haloscope, so no local DM density applies. The paper reports kinetic mixing chi sensitivity. Exclusion limits shown only in projection figures (Fig 6/7) generated from C. O'Hare AxionLimits; the only explicitly quoted numerical sensitivity in text is chi~1e-8 around m~1e-4 eV for the low-power Stage A. Stages B and C reach lower chi but no exact numbers given in text. Data points are rough estimates from text only — figure data not numerically tabulated. Confidence kept moderate due to lack of tabulated curve values. | Vision: Plot shows projected sensitivities (Stage A green, Stage B blue, Stage C red) for a coherent LSW dark photon search. The lower boundary traced corresponds to Stage C (the most sensitive, lowest red curve). These are projected reach curves, not yet exclusion limits. Peaks correspond to resonant cavity modes. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=13.9x
